title: Deep Sewers
html:
The main entrance of the Deep Sewers.

The Deep Sewers is a sewers themed interior that most commonly spawns on Narcotic. This interior can be claustrophobic and maze-like due to its long, narrow hallways and corridors that connect to each other.

> Rooms

  • Brick Maze - Corridors with sludge and waste that make up a large portion of the sewers. Scrap can generate in the areas with light and platforms, including the main entrance.
  • Valve Gate - A large valve connected to a gate that typically spawns close to the main entrance and always in part of the Brick Maze. Players can open this gate after completing a Secondary Objective.
  • Concrete Brick Maze - The other large portion of the sewers that frequently connects to loot rooms.
  • Large Tunnel - A large tunnel with various branching pathways that can connect to various parts of the interior.
  • Storage - A small room that generates with various objects, such as buttons on the right wall, shelving units, tools hanging on the left wall, etc. Scrap often spawns in these rooms.
  • Locker Storage - A room with a set of lockers that has a door leading into another room partially submerged in waste. Scrap often spawns in these lockers or in the partially submerged room.
  • Roof Grate - A small room with a sewer grate in the middle of the roof. The Snatcher can be heard and encountered here and scrap can occasionally generate here.
  • Long Pipe - An absurdly long pipe can generate that often connects to another part of the interior.

> Interior Features

  • Graffiti - Graffiti can be found on various walls in the sewers. Most of it is flavor text, but some of the graffiti hints at the existence of the Treasure Room and the Snatcher.
  • Snatcher - The Snatcher is a large creature that appears to be made up of waste with multiple eyes and limbs. The player can encounter it or its arms dangling through sewer grates at various points in the interior, but all of these encounters are auditory or visual.
  • The liquid present in the sewers depends on the moon the interior spawns on.

> Hazards

  • Snatcher (Entity) - At 05:00pm, there is a 50% chance for the Snatcher to spawn within the interior. It will roar and be heard by any players in the interior if it spawns. It is a variant of the Thumper with 8hp.

> Treasure Room

The treasure room at the bottom of the staircase.

The treasure room serves as the apparatus room for the interior and is its most prominent feature, although it does not have a guaranteed chance to spawn. It is a large room with many wooden platforms stacked to the left, where scrap can spawn, and a guaranteed key spawn and interactable wheel to the right. It also has a staircase submerged in toxic waste that rapidly deals 2 damage per hit to the player or 18 damage per hit to the player if they are near the bottom. At the bottom of the staircase there is a door, which can be locked, that opens to a room with many gold bars alongside cash registers, golden cups, pill bottles, and wedding rings. Other scrap can spawn in this room, though it is unlikely.

Turning the wheel temporarily begins to drain the toxic waste and allows for safe travel to the bottom, taking about 12 seconds from turning the wheel to fully drain. After about another 45 seconds, the sound of rushing water will be heard and the waste will begin to rise again. Once the waste has returned to its original position, the lights will begin flickering and the power will go out with a radiation warning shortly afterward.

If a player simply runs straight down and up the stairs with no strategy, tools, or additional modifications, it is possible retrieve up to three pill bottles and one cash register/gold bar while taking a little damage from the rising waste. Alternatively, the player can safely retrieve four cups/rings. This totals to an average of ▮204-264 depending on what scrap is taken.

Dropping off the staircase railings can be used as shortcuts to save a tremendous amount of time during the descent. When looking at the wheel, turn around and run towards the wall and railing, jump onto the railing, and fall onto the first outer railing below. From here, look at and push up against the wall, walk or jump off to the right while remaining as close to the railing as possible, and immediately begin moving left to land onto the second outer railing. This can be repeated to reach the third outer railing, or the player can fall straight from the first to the third outer railing, and places the player at the staircase leading to the door. The second and third falls are risky, however, as missing will usually result in death. This increases the total average to ▮268-368 depending on what scrap the player grabs and what risks they're willing to take, with the most feasible maximum being two pill bottles and two gold bars.

The player can also continuously drop and pick up a cash register while moving backwards to increase speed and decrease stamina usage overall. If executed correctly with the above shortcuts, a player can sacrifice most of their hp to retrieve two rings/cups, a gold bar, and a cash register for an average of ▮402. Since this requires an immense out of effort with little room for error, it is generally recommended to stick to safer and more consistent options.

Although a TZP-inhalant can be useful, it usually isn't worth the price as it can not be reused. An extension ladder usually gets stuck, but can create a platform to jump to the third outer railing with less risk. A jetpack can be used to safely make two trips for six gold bars, totaling to an average of ▮936, but can be cumbersome or risky to carry into the interior and it will likely take a bit of practice for players unfamiliar with using one.

> Secondary Objectives

The Valve Gate that has the reward room behind it.

One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn in the room behind the Valve Gate.

Fix the Flow Machines

If the graffiti on the wall by the Valve Gate mentions flow machines, players must find three flow machines in the interior. Players must repeatedly interact with the yellow valve and then push or pull the left and right levers to the respective left and right number position. The bottom lever position is 0 and the top lever position is 10. The lever moves up or down by 1 with each interaction. A sound effect will play after a flow machine is successfully fixed.

Once all three flow machines have been turned on, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the Valve Gate to enter the room and get their reward.

Restart the Power

If the graffiti on the wall next to the Valve Gate mentions the power box exploding, players must find two power boxes with several knobs in the interior. Players must turn each knob to the correct position indicated by a unique click sound when a player turns it to that position. These power boxes also have a written warning that faulty knobs, indicated by sparks coming out of the knob when turning it, must always be pointed upward. Trying to activate the power by pressing the red button and having a knob in an incorrect position will cause players to take 40 damage.

Once both power boxes are turned back on, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the Valve Gate to enter the room and get their reward.

Traverse the Sludge Tunnel

If the graffiti on the wall next to the Valve Gate mentions a sludge tunnel, players must go to the sludge tunnel in the Concrete Brick Maze with a yellow pipe leading to it. Inside will be an underwater maze and they must interact with several yellow valves to open the full path to a bigger valve at the end of the yellow pipe. The lights lead the way to the valves or the gates that valves open. Players must also return to the entrance of the Sludge Tunnel to avoid drowning with each trip.

Once the last valve has been interacted with, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the Valve Gate to enter the room and get their reward.

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by the vanilla luck system. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. Traverse the Sludge Tunnel is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier. Fix the Flow Machines and Restart the Power are considered Hard difficulty and have a 1.4x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

> Event: Deep Maintenance Elevator

An angled view of the Deep Maintenance Elevator.

The Deep Maintenance Elevator can randomly generate in the interior. It is a small, rectangular platform suspended above sewage.

As soon as a player stands on the elevator, both the sewage below it and the elevator itself will begin to descend. The Snatcher will appear and spray sewage onto the platform, causing it to become slippery. The Snatcher will then attempt to either hit players on the edges of the elevator, dealing 50 damage on contact, or attempt to knock players off the elevator by spitting streams of sludge at them that pushes them backwards. If players do fall off the elevator, they will likely die to fall damage or drown.

Players should try to make their movements small and precise to avoid gaining too much speed and sliding around uncontrollably. If the Snatcher is going to hit players with its spit, they can position themselves to get pushed into the columns or objects at the corners of the arena. A jetpack completely trivializes this event, as players can just activate their jetpack if they begin to fall off the elevator. An extension ladder can be used to some degree as well, but is often too finnicky to be of much use.

Eventually, the elevator will descend to a slightly open pipe and the Snatcher will disappear. Inside this pipe will be the Snatcher skullplate, which is the reward for the event. It is conductive, is two-handed, weighs 13lbs, and is worth ▮192 to ▮227. Players must collect the reward quickly before the elevator begins to rise back up without them on it.
